referenceRole: User screenshot visually inspected; translated into original shape and palette briefs, no game assets extracted.

prompts.title: 偏心爆裂
prompts.detail: Four different asymmetric BURST pigment clusters. Top left: lavender-grey impact with one strong broad diagonal torn shard and a few unequal blunt splayed arms, huge missing sector. Top right: mint-grey one-sided branching rupture, broad flat connected pigment plates with fissures and detached larger fragments. Bottom left: warm muted ochre crushed burst with low offset origin, broad irregular ragged petals, not circular. Bottom right: chalk ivory pale mint diagonal blast-shaped dry scumble with sparse separated large chips. Make them angular, broad, off-balance and irregular; avoid thin fireworks rays.
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production oil-paint decal ATLAS, square, high resolution, exactly FOUR independent paint shapes in a strict 2x2 layout. Each shape fully contained inside its quadrant with at least 10% empty margin around it, no touching adjacent shapes. Background absolutely pure flat BLACK RGB 0,0,0, intentionally a mask background, NOT transparency checkerboard. No labels, text, grid, frames, buildings or objects. These are original irregular pigment shapes for aged coastal-town wall paintovers: substantial flat broken opaque pigment areas, broad palette-knife dragged facets and dry brush fractures, painterly graphic silhouette, varied hard and soft torn edges, generous voids, very few tiny flecks. NOT photographed wet paint, not glossy impasto macro, not watercolor washes, no shadows, glow, fire, circular comic starburst, regular geometric rays, smooth gradients or uniform noise. Palette is dusty mint, muted lavender grey, chalk ivory, faded warm ochre; preserve same-hue internal value variation, small related hue inflections. Work from large silhouette and negative spaces first. At normal building viewing distance these read as broad paint gestures, NOT dense scratch textures.

prompts.title: 断续放射
prompts.detail: Four different interrupted FAN / RADIATING paint gestures. Top left: mint-grey five unequal broad splayed brush tongues opening upward from an offcenter origin with blank wedges. Top right: lavender-grey sideways fan, two broad dominant streaks, three shorter broken strokes, partial missing center. Bottom left: ochre-grey broken radial sweep across a wide arc only, disconnected large spatulate fragments. Bottom right: ivory blue-grey wind-sheared radiating scumble with wide forked sweep and uneven gaps. Asymmetric directional fans of pigment, no regular spokes or circular stars, no literal radiation effects.

prompts.title: 撕裂刮擦
prompts.detail: Four different TORN PALETTE-KNIFE pigment clusters. Top left: mint-grey tall angular fractured slab with large open gap and blunt scraped tongue. Top right: lavender-grey diagonal crossed drag, several broad flat facets, ripped negative channels and irregular missing corners. Bottom left: faded ochre peeling-like scattered contiguous plates, large chips with a few raw dragged streaks. Bottom right: dusty teal-grey jagged sweeping scrape, wide interrupted blade stroke and detached offset block. Each has a bold nonrectangular silhouette and internal coarse paint planes; not tiny speckled dirt.

prompts.title: 骨白破边
prompts.detail: Four distinct IVORY EDGE and fractured dry paint shapes. All predominantly warm chalk ivory with pale cool mint-grey inflections. Top left: vertically stretched torn corner scumble with several irregular gaps and one strong flare sideways. Top right: offcenter shattered pale pigment burst with broad broken lobes, interior voids and irregular contour. Bottom left: low horizontal wall-foot scrape, uneven shelf of dry pigment with sparse blunt upward tongues and large interruptions. Bottom right: loosely branching pale fractured fan, broad broken strokes, exposed empty wedges, asymmetric open silhouette. Preserve substantial pale areas and varied torn edges without fine all-over noise.
